## 8. Bugs that block this work (for the parallel debug session) and coordination notes

Hard blocker: amoeboid-amateur-guillemot (1768-5b6f-958a-43e9, priority 1), the marker-blind --update-stale refusal (entry 5). Seven epics depend on it.
Pipeline bugs every change of this release passes through: asbestine-inaccurate-sanderling (17e5, async plan review lost as stale-running); trivial-protected-barracuda (85a5, MCP 502 after concurrent gate load) and enduring-ironclad-arrowana (3499, whole-store compile held for the full review); exorcismal-tokophobic-agama (4bd0, correcting an AC on a near-cap reviewed ticket traps it; three of our stories sit within 300 characters of the cap); synonymous-autophobic-numbat (b251, spurious "0 commits behind" refusal); ergophobic-harassed-peacock (1e24) and imprudent-national-monkey (7c9b), transport and autodeploy faults voted Verified -1; complex-sassy-blackfly (5ee6, review-bot dead while autodeploy reports healthy).
Bugs whose fix collides with our file impact, with coordination notes posted on both sides: prenatal-maudlin-seahorse (dbe7, duplicate-creation aggregation, same journal the overlap story re-enables); unaware-subwealthy-pintail (f778, fix lives in reconciler modules the package move relocates); trustful-combative-grackle (9c64, would add to test_ci_workflow_parity.py, which the test-suite epic rewrites); tsaristic-intimate-boto (1424, import-convention visibility, partly addressed by the TID251 story); hyperbolic-humanoid-owl (658e) and discrete-unrelative-vervet (a50a), fcntl guards adjacent to config-epic edits.
Not a bug but a collision: task arterial-bilineate-vampirebat (a01e-01e7-6e6e-4809) also targets ADR 0117; our three ADR numbers are placeholders resolved at landing.
Other coordination comments posted: fuchsia-wettish-leafbird (two split-guard files the seam story deletes); disgusted-fretful-hare (the _LLM_KNOWN_KEYS carve-out and the [llm.evals] reader); the MCP derivation story (the _WIRED_GATES census and the parity script's deletion order); the durations story and the last held-out merge story (recapture .test_durations after the renames); the reconciler move story (landing instruction for the force-submit; two phantom design-doc comment rewrites owned by the docs epic).
